ticket.title: Service Queues always shows “Scheduled for today” and “On time”
ticket.text:
Service Queues always shows “Scheduled for today” and “On time”

When a patient row is expanded in Service Queues, the current-visit header always displays “Scheduled for today” and “On time” beneath the visit type. Neither label is derived from appointment data or a punctuality attribute. This presents unsupported scheduling information as fact, including for visits without that data.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open Service Queues and the Outpatient Clinic waiting list.
2. Expand a patient with a loaded current visit and no appointment/punctuality data.
3. Inspect the labels beneath the visit type.

## Actual result

“Scheduled for today” and “On time” appear regardless of whether the visit has supporting scheduling or punctuality data.

## Expected result

Only display scheduling and punctuality claims supported by actual data. When unavailable, omit the labels or show an explicitly unknown state. A visit start date alone does not establish an appointment or punctuality.

## Evidence

Independently verified in the release-tagged source:

- v12.0.0 current-visit-summary.component.tsx, lines 84–89: both translated labels render unconditionally once the visit is loaded.
- v12.0.0 unit test: a fixture with only visitType and encounters, with no visit date or attributes, is expected to show both labels.
- v11.1.0 baseline component: same unconditional labels.
- Already documented under Service Queues Technical Reference — Known issues and caveats.

The current visit shows “Scheduled for today” and “On time”. Both labels appear without checking appointment or punctuality data.

## Suggested fix and acceptance

Remove the unconditional labels until they can be backed by real scheduling/punctuality data. Update the unit test so a visit without that data does not claim “Scheduled for today” or “On time”. If data-derived labels are retained, cover supported and missing-data cases.

understanding.intent: Remove or conditionally show the 'Scheduled for today' and 'On time' labels in Service Queues so they only appear when backed by actual scheduling and punctuality data.

criteria.text: When a patient row is expanded in Service Queues for a visit lacking scheduling or punctuality data, 'Scheduled for today' and 'On time' must not be unconditionally displayed (omit them or show an explicit unknown state).
criteria.quote: Only display scheduling and punctuality claims supported by actual data. When unavailable, omit the labels or show an explicitly unknown state.

criteria.text: When valid appointment or punctuality data exists, display scheduling and punctuality labels that match the actual visit data.
criteria.quote: If data-derived labels are retained, cover supported and missing-data cases.

questions: Should the labels be completely removed in all cases for now, or should they be displayed conditionally when appointment/punctuality data is present?
When appointment or punctuality data is unavailable, should the labels be omitted entirely or display a specific placeholder/unknown text?
